info.title: Cernion Energy Tools API
info.description:
MicroService Agent System for Energy Markets - REST API with AI integration.

CERNION_TOKEN: request at https://cernion.de/ or by email: dev@stromdao.com.

For the public instance at https://api.cernion.de/, create your token at https://cernion.de/cet-token/.

Complements authoritative VNBDigital data (Layer 1) with visible substations, transformers, and lines. Data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 — https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/

tags.name: OEP (Open Energy Platform)
tags.description: Read-only access to Open Energy Platform research and scenario datasets. No authentication required for public tables. Supports schema/table discovery, column metadata, row queries, and full-text search. API: https://openenergyplatform.org/api/v0

tags.name: Knowledge RAG
tags.description: HyDE-aware RAG access with tenant-local ingestion and vector indexing. Supports semantic search, scroll/fetch/collection info, collection lifecycle, datasource/audit ingestion, and reindex/cutover.

tags.name: Finance Agent
tags.description: Deterministic finance/regulatory analysis for VNBs (v0.40). Performs query planning, ontology-aware RAG retrieval, L1/L2 evidence arbitration, and guarded synthesis with audit trail.

tags.name: Personal Agent
tags.description: Interactive personal chat orchestration (v0.52). Builds deterministic L0-L4 context stacks with strict token budgeting. Layer 4 is transient and never persisted.

tags.name: OpenAI Compatible
tags.description: Inbound OpenAI-compatible facade for authenticated Cernion advisory completions.

tags.name: Actor Personas
tags.description: Tenant-scoped actor persona registry for HITL routing, notification ownership, and persona-aware inbox delivery.

tags.name: Grid Connection Validation
tags.description: Deterministic 6-step Netzanschluss validation pipeline (v0.14). Produces structured findings and a Go/No-Go decision sealed with a PouchDB snapshot for audit integrity. No LLM involvement — identical inputs always produce identical finding codes.

tags.name: Energy Sharing Validation
tags.description: Deterministic 6-step Energy Sharing community validation pipeline (v0.15). Validates generator MaStR records, Direktvermarkter status (§ 21 Abs. 2 EEG), share allocations, and § 42c EnWG eligibility. Interims-Prozess for VNBs ahead of § 20b EnWG central platform. No LLM involvement — identical inputs always produce identical finding codes.

tags.name: Energy Sharing Allocation
tags.description: Deterministic 6-step Energy Sharing allocation engine (v0.16). Computes per-consumer 15-min allocation time-series (§ 12 StromNZV) for § 42c EnWG communities. Stufe A: synthetic forecast via mastr_generation_forecast. Stufe B: real iMSys metering data via inhouse CSV upload. KRITIS-compliant: time-series computed in RAM, only metadata persisted. Interimsprozess operative deadline: 01.06.2026 (§ 20b EnWG).

tags.name: MaStR Data Quality
tags.description: Deterministic 8-step MaStR portfolio quality audit (v0.17). Audits the entire VNB portfolio in MaStR: VNB identity → full inventory → status anomalies → capacity anomalies → connection point integrity → duplicate detection → geo spot check → audit trail. Returns a qualityScore (0–100) across 5 weighted dimensions. No LLM involvement. Steps 3–7 independently skippable via skipSteps parameter.

tags.name: Redispatch Ex-Post
tags.description: Deterministic 7-step Redispatch 2.0 Ex-Post settlement audit (v0.18). Cross-references MaStR portfolio (≥100 kW) with Netztransparenz curtailment data: VNB identity → portfolio inventory → master data validation → curtailment correlation → settlement readiness → financial risk assessment → audit trail. Returns settlementReadiness (% of installations ready for A96 settlement) and riskAssessment (estimated lost compensation in €). No LLM involvement. Regulatory basis: §§ 13, 13a EnWG, NABEG, StromNZV, Redispatch 2.0 (BDEW/BNetzA). Steps 3–6 independently skippable via skipSteps parameter.

tags.name: Dashboard API
tags.description: UI-optimised aggregate endpoints (v0.19). Each endpoint consolidates 4–7 internal service calls into a single response, reducing the roundtrips required for an Enterprise UI dashboard page to one. Read-only — no side-effects, no own PouchDB. Endpoints: vnb-overview (VNB identity + KPIs + latest agent results), market-snapshot (spot prices + CO₂ + renewable forecast), quality-summary (recent reports from all agent pipelines), observability-mini (compact health/incidents/performance cards), finding-codes (complete 100-code reference with metadata for UI tooltips).

tags.name: Observability
tags.description: Read-only production feedback endpoints (v0.40.7) for captured service log output, action performance metrics, compact operational summaries, and an agent-ready debugging prompt. Data is retained locally in PouchDB with redaction-safe storage.

tags.name: Companies
tags.description: Company entity management (v0.20.3). Groups multiple BDEW market-partner codes that belong to the same economic unit (Konzernverbund / Stadtwerk). Supports autoDiscover (cernion_market_partners query → draft → confirm flow) and manual member management. enrichResults enriches market-partner search results with companyId + marketRole.

tags.name: Zielnetzplanung (ZNP)
tags.description: Stateful workspace API for target grid planning (v0.20.4). Each project is an in-memory graphology graph for a geographic bounding box. Data Layers are loaded iteratively: Layer 0 (MaStR assets), Layer 1 (OSM buildings — stub), Layer 2 (transformer loads — stub). All assets in Layer 0 connect to a virtual substation SUB_1 (MaStR has no topology). Graph state is persisted in PouchDB (meta + graph split docs) and hydrated on service start. Project metadata (bbox, layer counts) is persisted alongside graph topology.

tags.name: Object Store
tags.description: Generic namespaced document store backed by PouchDB (v0.20.5). Provides CRUD and Mango-query operations for frontend persistence (ZNP workspaces, user settings, etc.) without backend schema changes. Documents are keyed as namespace:key; namespace isolation enforced in all queries.

tags.name: Cookbook
tags.description: Reusable API workflow recipes (v0.20.5). Code-managed community cookbook with semantic lookup, runtime relation graph, and periodic validity checks against live microservice actions.

tags.name: Agent Receipts
tags.description: Runtime-managed receipt documents (v0.54.0 foundation). PouchDB-backed CRUD, validation, lifecycle status transitions, and auditable soft-delete.

tags.name: CYA Agent
tags.description: Stakeholder-perspective argumentation engine with regulatory grounding (v0.26). Generates data-backed, profile-aware narratives from Cernion microservice data + OEO regulatory context.

tags.name: EDM (Energiedatenmanagement)
tags.description: Meter data management with SQLite-backed timeseries storage, MeLo registry, and measurement concepts (v0.28). KRITIS-compliant embedded storage with quarterly partitioning.

tags.name: SLP (Standardlastprofile)
tags.description: Standard load profiles (BDEW H0/G0/L0) and custom profiles for load estimation, settlement, and forecast baseline.

tags.name: Settlement (Abrechnung)
tags.description: Redispatch compensation (§13a/14 EnWG), EEG revenue calculation, and A96 settlement export. Based on EDM timeseries, generation forecasts, and ENTSO-E market prices with KRITIS fallbacks.

tags.name: Forecast (Prognostik)
tags.description: Load forecasting (SLP-based with historical correction), generation forecasting (MCP with KRITIS fallback), residual load calculation, Day-Ahead scheduling, storage dispatch optimization, and forecast quality evaluation (RMSE/MAE/MAPE).

tags.name: Flex (§14a Flexibilitätsmanagement)
tags.description: Controllable consumption device management (§14a EnWG). SVE registry, dimming planning with grid capacity analysis, MQTT-based execution, Entlastungsnachweis, and tariff reduction.

tags.name: MaStR Monitor
tags.description: MaStR installation change monitoring with field-level delta detection and email notifications (v0.27). Watches track changes to MaStR installations based on saved queries with configurable schedules.

tags.name: HITL
tags.description: Human-in-the-loop approval workflow with tenant-scoped review items, intervention trail, and lifecycle events.

tags.name: Investment Planning
tags.description: Deterministic investment planning and budget steering (v0.51.2) with hybrid Soll baselines, Redispatch Ex-Post Ist comparison, mandate alignment checks, and >1M EUR HITL triggers.

tags.name: Blindflug Radar
tags.description: Deterministic disturbance-to-investment signal correlation (v0.51.3) using Redispatch, MaStR monitor deltas, and quality findings with confidence-threshold auto-proposals.

tags.name: Netzfahrplan / fNAV
tags.description: Deterministic fNAV feasibility assessment (v0.51.5): capacity model (firm + flexible + curtailment), N-1 check with hybrid threshold (domain default + tenant/project/scenario override), technical feasibility verdict, governance gate (Option B: requires_governance_decision until legal + contract prerequisites met), and TOTEX-based economics with eog-calculator integration.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Outbound webhook subscriptions with signed delivery, retry backoff, replay, and dead-letter tracking.

post.summary: Prepare VDMI matrix nomination — draft only, no write

consequentialAction.description: The Phase 3 execute action that would perform this change

422.description: Matrix status does not allow nomination

post.description: Analyses the VDMI matrix and returns a draft nomination proposal. No writes: This action creates no persisted state. The returned draft must be explicitly confirmed by a consequential execute action (Phase 3). Set requiredConfirmation: true in the response means Copilot must ask the user to confirm before proceeding.

correlationId.description: Caller-supplied trace ID for audit logging

post.summary: Draft evidence suggestions for open VDMI tasks — no write
post.description: Analyses open VDMI tasks and returns structured evidence suggestions for each. No writes: This returns suggestions only. No evidence is added to the matrix. Use POST /api/vdmi/:id/evidence (Phase 3) to actually inject evidence.

post.summary: Prepare grid connection validation config — draft only, no write

proposedValidation.description: Parameters that would be passed to the consequential execute action

post.description: Validates the input parameters and returns a draft validation configuration. No writes: This action has no side effects. The returned proposal must be confirmed before the actual 6-step pipeline is started. At least one of gridOperatorId, gridOperatorBdew, or gridOperatorName is required. The consequential execute action (POST /api/grid-connection/validate) is Phase 3.

post.summary: Prepare VDMI evidence injection intent — creates auditable intent, no write
post.description: Verifies the VDMI matrix exists and creates a persistent ProcessExecutionIntent for evidence injection. No evidence is written. Returns intentId, expiresAt, and confirmationMessage. Execute via executeProcessIntent outside Copilot.

post.summary: Prepare ZNP planning assumption intent — creates auditable intent, no write
post.description: Verifies the ZNP project exists and creates a persistent ProcessExecutionIntent for adding a planning assumption. No write occurs. Returns intentId, expiresAt, and confirmationMessage. Execute via executeProcessIntent outside Copilot.

post.summary: Prepare connection rejection evidence package intent — creates auditable intent, no write
post.description: Validates all required fields and creates a persistent ProcessExecutionIntent for creating a connection rejection evidence package. No write occurs. Returns intentId, expiresAt, and confirmationMessage. Execute via executeProcessIntent outside Copilot.

post.summary: Ask Cernion for compact evidence and process context

200.description: Compact Cernion answer for Copilot composition

groundingAnswer.description: Prompt-ready Cernion grounding package for Copilot composition. Contains user question, answer, evidence, guardrails, risks, open questions and answer rules in one text field.

consultingBrief.description: Optional backend-generated consulting brief for Copilot. It structures the evidence but is not a standalone source of facts.

retrievalHint.description: Optional vector/retrieval text for topic orientation; not standalone answer evidence.

evidenceBySource.description: Evidence grouped by source: entities, knowledge, datapoints, and object-store objects.

guardrails.description: Instructions Copilot must apply before composing the final answer.

resolved.description: Blueprint/Capability resolution outcome (energychain/cernion-energy-tools#271). kind is "blueprint" when a read-only execution plan was compiled, "none" otherwise.

canonicalInputs.description: Normalized inputs used to compile the execution plan, if any.

recommendedEndpoints.description: Read-only endpoint recommendations (energychain/cernion-energy-tools#271 architecture follow-up). Cernion recommends which approved read-only endpoint(s) are the evidence surface for this request and what each result set means fachlich — it does not execute them or synthesize a final answer; that is the responsibility of the consuming agent/orchestrator. May contain more than one complementary endpoint.

resultSemantics.description: Fachliche Bedeutung des Result-Sets dieses Endpoints.

execution.description: Alias of recommendedEndpoints[0] for backward compatibility with #271 consumers that only read a single plan, or null when none is available.

noPlanReason.description: Present when resolved.kind is "none" — explains why no executable read-only plan was available.

post.description: Use this read-only action first for Cernion questions. It returns compact evidence, process context, risks, open questions and next steps. Copilot should use the structure to compose the final user-facing answer. It never executes, confirms, signs, deletes or modifies process data.

question.description: User question to answer with Cernion evidence and process context.
question.example: Welcher VNB ist in Wiesloch zuständig?

context.description: Optional tenant, user, object, process or document context.

inputs.description: Optional canonical structured input values (e.g. assetType, location, minCapacity, maxCapacity, commissioningYear, limit) for Blueprint read-only REST-plan compilation. Separate from context.

mode.description: Controls whether the answer should focus on evidence or process checks.

maxEvidence.description: Maximum number of evidence items returned.

includeFederatedKnowledge.description: Opt-in only (default false, does not change the default evidence sources/output shape). When true, additionally queries knowledge-rag.federatedSearch (Marktkommunikation/regulatory collections) and includes it as an advisory evidenceBySource.federatedKnowledge entry.
